echoParts: in the name of the Father
verseText: Therefore go and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit...
meaning: This is the Great Commission: the mission Jesus gave to his followers. Our job is to be disciples who go and make new disciples all over the world.

recall.question: What did Jesus tell His followers to make?

meaning.question: What is the Great Commission?
choices: Jesus' mission for followers to make disciples
A rule only for the apostles
